sanskrit: agniṁ naro dīdhitibhir araṇyor hastacyutī janayanta praśastam | dūredṛśaṁ gṛhapatiṁ atharyum ||
english: Men generate the praiseworthy Agni by the friction of two fire-sticks, letting them fall from their hands — him who is visible from afar, the householder, the Atharvan.

sanskrit: tam agnim aste vasavo ny ṛṇvan supraticakṣam avase kutaś cit | dakṣāyyo yo dama āsa nityaḥ ||
english: The Vasus have kindled that Agni within, well-visible, for protection from every quarter — he who is ever capable and constant in the house.

sanskrit: preddho agne dīdihi puro no 'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha | tvāṁ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ ||
english: Blazing forth, O Agni, shine before our dwellings with unceasing flame, O youngest one; to you, ever and again, the prizes of the contest come.

sanskrit: pra te agnayo 'gnibhyo varaṁ niḥ suvīrāsaḥ śośucanta dyumantaḥ | yatrā naraḥ samāsate sujātāḥ ||
english: Your fires, excellent beyond all other fires, have blazed forth brilliantly, rich in heroes — there where the well-born men are assembled together.

sanskrit: dā no agne dhiyā rayiṁ suvīraṁ svāpatyaṁ sahasya praśastam | na yaṁ yāvā tarati yātumāvān ||
english: Grant us, O Agni, through our prayer, wealth rich in heroes, a praiseworthy progeny, O mighty one — wealth which no malevolent sorcerer can overcome.

sanskrit: upa yam eti yuvatiḥ sudakṣaṁ doṣā vastor haviṣmatī ghṛtācī | upa svainam aramatiḥ vasūyuḥ ||
english: To him, the highly capable one, the youthful woman, bearing oblations, ghee-laden, comes by night and at dawn; and Aramatī, seeking wealth, comes near to him.

sanskrit: viśvā agne 'pa daharātīr yebhis tapobhir adaho jarūtham | pra nisvaram cātayasvāmīvām ||
english: Burn away, O Agni, all hostilities — with those heats wherewith you burned up the Jarūtha; chase away soundlessly the disease that afflicts us.

sanskrit: ā yas te agna idhate anīkaṁ vasiṣṭha śukra dīdivaḥ pāvaka | uto na ebhiḥ stavathair iha syāḥ ||
english: He who kindles your flame, O Agni — O Vasiṣṭha, O bright one, shining, purifying — may you be here with us through these praises.

sanskrit: vi ye te agne bhejire anīkam martā naraḥ pitryāsaḥ purutrā | uto na ebhiḥ sumanā iha syāḥ ||
english: Those mortal men, heroes following the fathers' way, who have shared in your flame in many places — may you be here, well-disposed, with us through these same praises.

sanskrit: ime naro vṛtrahateyu śūrā viśvā adevīr abhi santu māyāḥ | ye me dhiyam panayanta praśastām ||
english: Let these heroic men, in the slaying of Vṛtra, overcome all godless sorceries — those who admire my praiseworthy prayer.

sanskrit: mā śūne agne ni ṣadāma nṛṇām māśeṣaso 'vīratā pari tvā | prajāvatīṣu duryāsu durya ||
english: May we not sit helpless among men, O Agni; may there be no childlessness and no herolessness around you; grant us houses and homes full of progeny, O householder.

sanskrit: yam aśvī nityam upayāti yajñam prajāvantaṁ svāpatyaṁ kṣayaṁ naḥ | svajanamanā śeṣasā vāvṛdhānam ||
english: The horse-possessing sacrifice ever approaches him: grant us an abode rich in progeny and in good offspring, grown great by its own birth and its remainder.

sanskrit: pāhi no agne rakṣaso ajuṣṭāt pāhi dhūrter araruṣo aghāyoḥ | tvā yujā pṛtanāyūṁr abhi ṣyām ||
english: Protect us, O Agni, from the unpleasant demon; protect us from the trickery of the evil-minded, harm-seeking one; allied with you, may we overcome those who attack us.

sanskrit: sed agnir agnīṁr aty astv anyān yatra vājī tanayo vīḻupāṇiḥ | sahasrapāthā akṣarā sameti ||
english: May that Agni surpass all other fires — where the prize-winning son, strong-handed, gathers the thousand-footed, undying syllables.

sanskrit: sed agnir yo vanuṣyato nipāti sameddh āram aṁhaso uruṣyāt | sujātāsaḥ pari caranti vīrāḥ ||
english: That is the Agni who protects his kindler from the assailant, who rescues the sacrificer from distress — around whom the well-born heroes gather.

sanskrit: ayaṁ so agnir āhutaḥ purutrā yam īśānaḥ sam id indhe haviṣmān | pari yam ety adhvareṣu hotā ||
english: This is that Agni, invoked in many places, whom the lord, bearing oblations, kindles together; around whom the hotr-priest goes in the sacrificial rites.

sanskrit: tve agna āhavanāni bhūrī śānāsa ā juhuyāma nityā | ubhā kṛṇvanto vahatū miyedhe ||
english: Into you, O Agni, may we pour many oblations, sovereign and constant; we two making both the bridal pair go to the wedding feast.

sanskrit: imo agne vītatamāni havyā jasro vakṣi devatātiṁ accha | prati na īṁ surabhīṇi vyantu ||
english: These most eagerly desired oblations, O Agni — carry them as the undying one toward the gathering of gods; may the sweet-smelling ones come back to us.

sanskrit: mā no agne 'vīrate parā dā durvāsase 'mataye mā no asyai | mā naḥ kṣudhe mā rakṣasaḥ ṛtāvo mā no dame mā vana ā juhūrthāḥ ||
english: Deliver us not, O Agni, to herolessness; not to ill-clad poverty; not to hunger; not to demons, O lord of ṛta; mislead us not in the house nor in the forest.

sanskrit: nū me brahmāṇy agna uc chaśādhi tvaṁ deva maghavadbhyaḥ suṣūdaḥ | rātau syāmo bhayāsa ā te yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Proclaim my prayers now, O Agni; pour them forth, O god, for the generous lords; may we stand in your gift; preserve us evermore with blessings.

sanskrit: tvam agne suhavo raṇvasaṁdṛk sudītī sūno sahaso didīhi | mā tve sacā tanaye nitya ā dhaṅ mā vīro asman naryo vi dāsīt ||
english: You, O Agni, are pleasant to invoke, gladsome to behold; shine brightly, O son of strength, with fair light; may no son ever be lost from us who cling to you; may no manly hero perish from among us.

sanskrit: mā no agne durbhṛtaye sacaiṣu deveddheuṣv agniṣu pra vocaḥ | mā te asmān durmatayu bhṛmāc cid devasya sūno sahaso naśanta ||
english: O Agni, in these god-kindled fires, proclaim not our ill-maintenance; may no evil thought of yours, however slight, O son of strength, destroy us.

sanskrit: sa marto agne svanīka revān amartye ya ājuhoti havyam | sa devatā vasuvaniṁ dadhāti yaṁ sūrir arthī pṛcchamāna eti ||
english: That mortal is wealthy, O Agni of fair face, who pours oblations to you, the immortal; he places in the deity a treasure of goods — to him the wise patron comes asking his wish.

sanskrit: maho no agne suvitasya vidvān rayiṁ sūribhya ā vahā bṛhantam | yena vayaṁ sahasāvan madema avikṣitāsa āyuṣā suvīrāḥ ||
english: O Agni, knowing the great prosperity, bring ample wealth to the patrons; whereby, O mighty one, we may rejoice with undiminished life and fine heroes.

sanskrit: nū me brahmāṇy agna uc chaśādhi tvaṁ deva maghavadbhyaḥ suṣūdaḥ | rātau syāmo bhayāsa ā te yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Proclaim my prayers now, O Agni; pour them forth, O god, for the generous lords; may we stand in your gift; preserve us evermore with blessings.

sanskrit: juṣasva naḥ samidham agne adya śocā bṛhad yajataṁ dhūmam ṛṇvan | upa spṛśa divyaṁ sānu stūpaiḥ saṁ raśmibhis tatanaḥ sūryasya ||
english: Be pleased, O Agni, with our kindling-wood today; blaze high, sending forth the majestic smoke of worship; touch the back of heaven with your crests and spread out together with the rays of the sun.

sanskrit: narāśaṁsasya mahimānam eṣām upa stoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ | ye sukratavaḥ śucayo dhiyaṁdhāḥ svadanti devā ubhayāni havyā ||
english: We will praise with our sacrifices the greatness of Narāśaṃsa of the adorable ones — those gods, of good wisdom, pure, who are the layers of prayer, who savour both kinds of oblations.

sanskrit: īḻenyaṁ vo asuraṁ sudakṣam antar dūtaṁ rodasī satyavācam | manuṣvad agnim manunā samiddhaṁ sam adhvarāya sadam in mahema ||
english: We would always magnify for the sacrifice him who is praiseworthy, the mighty, highly capable lord, the truthful messenger between heaven and earth — Agni kindled by Manu after the manner of Manu.

sanskrit: saparyavo bharamāṇā abhijñu pra vṛñjate namasā barhir agnau | ājuhvānā ghṛtapṛṣṭham pṛṣadvad adhvaryavo haviṣā marjayadhvam ||
english: The worshippers, carrying the offerings, kneel and strew the sacred grass in the fire with reverence; O adhvaryu-priests, cleanse the oblation while pouring — the spotted one whose back is anointed with ghee.

sanskrit: svādhyo vi duro devayanto 'śiśrayū rathayur devatātā | pūrvī śiśuṁ na mātarā rihāṇe sam agr uvo na samaneṣv añjan ||
english: Wise in prayer, desiring the gods, the worshippers have thrown open the doors at the gathering of deities, eager as charioteers; the two (Dawn and Night), like two mothers licking their young, have anointed him who is one at the assemblies.

sanskrit: uta yoṣaṇe divye mahī na uṣāsānaktā sudughe va dhenuḥ | barhiṣadā puruhūte maghonī ā yajñiye suvitāya śrayetām ||
english: And the two great divine women — Dawn and Night — like a good-milking cow yielding milk: may those two wealthy, often-invoked, adorable ones who sit upon the sacred grass come near for our well-being.

sanskrit: viprā yajñeṣu mānuṣeṣu kārū manye vāṁ jātavedasā yajadhyai | ūrdhvaṁ no adhvaraṁ kṛtaṁ haveṣu tā deveṣu vanatho vāryāṇi ||
english: Two inspired crafters — so I think — at human sacrifices do we invoke you both, O Jātavedas pair, to worship; make our sacrifice stand upright among the invocations; win for us the desirable things among the gods.

sanskrit: ā bhāratī bhāratībhiḥ sajoṣā iḷā devair manuṣyebhir agniḥ | sarasvatī sārasvatebhir arvāk tisro devīr barhir edaṁ sadantu ||
english: May Bhāratī with the Bhāratī goddesses, Iḷā with gods and men, and Agni, and Sarasvatī with the Sārasvatī beings come hither — may the three goddesses sit upon this sacred grass.

sanskrit: tan nas turīpam adha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭar vi rarāṇaḥ svasva | yato vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ sudakṣo yuktagrāvā jāyate devakāmaḥ ||
english: Pour that nourishing sap upon us, O god Tvaṣṭṛ, granting freely; from which is born the heroic, capable man of action, well-skilled, who works the pressing stones and desires the gods.

sanskrit: vanaspate 'va sṛjopa devān agnir haviḥ śamitā sūdayāti | sed u hotā satyataro yajāti yathā devānāṁ janimāni veda ||
english: O Lord of the Forest, release the gods; Agni the sacrificer will prepare the oblation; he himself, the true hotr-priest, shall sacrifice as he knows the births of the gods.

sanskrit: ā yāhy agne samidhāno arvāṅ indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṁ turebhiḥ | barhir na āstām aditiḥ suputrā svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||
english: Come hither, O Agni, blazing, together with Indra and the swift gods on one chariot; may Aditi of fair sons be seated on the sacred grass; Svāhā! — may the immortal gods rejoice.

sanskrit: agniṁ vo devam agnibhiḥ sajoṣā yajiṣṭhaṁ dūtam adhvare kṛṇudhvam | yo martyeṣu nidhruvi ṛtāvā tapurmūrdhā ghṛtānnaḥ pāvakaḥ ||
english: Together, make Agni your god, together with the Agni flames — the most adorable, the divine messenger of the sacrifice — he who among mortals is the firm upholder of ṛta, of fiery forehead, ghee-fed, the purifier.

sanskrit: prothad aśvo na yavase 'viṣyan yadā mahaḥ saṁvaraṇād vy asthāt | ād asya vāto anu vāti śocir adha sma te vrajanam kṛṣṇam asti ||
english: He snorts like a horse at pasture, straining forward, when he steps forth from his great enclosure; then the wind fans his flame after it, and your track is black.

sanskrit: ud yasya te navajātasya vṛṣṇo 'gne caranty ajarā idhānāḥ | acchā dyām aruṣo dhūma eti saṁ dūto agna īyase hi devān ||
english: When your ageless flames go forth as the new-born bull, O Agni, the reddish smoke ascends toward the sky; for you, the messenger, go to the gods.

sanskrit: vi yasya te pṛthivyām pājo aśret tṛṣu yad annā samavṛkta jambhaiḥ | seneva sṛṣṭā prasitis ṭa eti yavaṁ na dasma juhvā vivekṣi ||
english: Your blazing force has spread across the earth; when it crumples dry vegetation with its jaws, your attack goes forth like a loosed army; you separate the grain with your tongue like a wondrous being.

sanskrit: tam id doṣā tam uṣasi yaviṣṭham agnim atyaṁ na marjayanta naraḥ | niśiśānā atithim asya yonau dīdāya śocir āhutasya vṛṣṇaḥ ||
english: Him, the youngest, they groom at night and at dawn like a swift horse — the men who have sharpened him; the guest kindled in his own place blazes forth, the flame of the bull who receives the oblation.

sanskrit: susaṁdṛk te svanīka pratīkaṁ vi yad rukmo na rocasa upāke | divo na te tanyatur eti śuṣmaś citro na sūraḥ prati cakṣi bhānum ||
english: Your face, of fair visage, is beautiful to behold when you blaze brilliantly at close range like golden ornament; your power surges like the thunder of heaven — show your brilliance, resplendent as the sun.

sanskrit: yathā vaḥ svāhāgnaye dāśema parīḷābhir ghṛtavadbhiś ca havyaiḥ | tebhir no agne amitair mahobhiḥ śataṁ pūrbhir āyasībhir ni pāhi ||
english: As we would offer to Agni with Svāhā, surrounded by ghee-laden oblations — with those unlimited great powers, O Agni, protect us with a hundred iron fortresses.

sanskrit: yā vā te santi dāśuṣe adhṛṣṭā giro vā yābhir nṛvatīr uruṣyāḥ | tābhir naḥ sūno sahaso ni pāhi smat sūrīñ jaritṝñ jātavedaḥ ||
english: Or those unassailable gifts you have for the worshipper, or those words of praise with which you rescue him who has heroes — with those, O son of strength, O Jātavedas, protect us, our patrons and our praisers.

sanskrit: nir yat pūteva svadhitiḥ śucir gāt svayā kṛpā tanvā rocamānaḥ | ā yo mātraur uśenyo janiṣṭa devayajyāya sukratuḥ pāvakaḥ ||
english: When like a pure axe he went forth shining, glowing with his own splendid body — he who was born, longed for, from the two mothers, the wise, purifying one for the worship of the gods.

sanskrit: etā no agne saubhagā didīhy api kratuṁ sucetasaṁ vatema | viśvā stotṛbhyo gṛṇate ca santu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Illuminate these auspicious things for us, O Agni; may we attain to clear-minded wisdom; may all these be for those who praise and hymn you; preserve us evermore with blessings.

sanskrit: pra vaḥ śukrāya bhāvane bharadhvaṁ havyam matiṁ cāgnaye supūtam | yo daivyāni mānuṣā janūṁṣy antar viśvāni vidmanā jigāti ||
english: Bring forth for the bright, shining one, oblation and well-purified prayer for Agni — he who, moving among them with his knowledge, goes between all divine and human generations.

sanskrit: sa gṛtso agnis taruṇaś cid astu yato yaviṣṭho ajaniṣṭa mātuḥ | saṁ yo vanā yuvate śucidan bhūri cid annā sam id atti sadyaḥ ||
english: Let him be the wise Agni, ever young, since the youngest was born from his mother; he who draws the forests together, consuming the clean food, who eats up great quantities of food forthwith.

sanskrit: asya devasya saṁsady anīke yam martāsaḥ śyetaṁ jagṛbhre | ni yo gṛbham pauruṣeyīm uvoca durokam agnir āyave śuśoca ||
english: In the assembly and army of this god whom the mortals have grasped as the white one — he who has declared the human grip to be difficult of abode: Agni has shone forth for Āyu.

sanskrit: ayaṁ kavir akaviṣu pracetā marteṣv agnir amṛto ni dhāyi | sa mā no atra juhuraḥ sahasvaḥ sadā tve sumanasaḥ syāma ||
english: This Agni, the poet, the all-knowing among the ignorant, the immortal, has been placed among mortals; may he not lead us astray here, O mighty one; may we always be well-disposed toward you.

sanskrit: ā yo yoniṁ devakṛtaṁ sasāda kratvā hy agnir amṛtāṁ atārīt | tam oṣadhīś ca vaninaś ca garbham bhūmiś ca viśvadhāyasam bibharti ||
english: He who has settled into the god-made womb — for by his wisdom Agni has crossed over to the immortals — him, the all-nourishing embryo, the herbs, the trees, and the earth bear.

sanskrit: īśe hy agnir amṛtasya bhūrer īśe rāyaḥ suvīryasya dātoḥ | mā tvā vayaṁ sahasāvann avīrā māpsavaḥ pari ṣadāma māduvaḥ ||
english: For Agni is master of great immortality, master of giving wealth and excellent heroism; may we not sit around you, O mighty one, without heroes, without cattle, without soma.

sanskrit: pariṣadyaṁ hy araṇasya rekṇo nityasya rāyaḥ patayaḥ syāma | na śeṣo agne anyajātam asty acetānasya mā patho vi dukṣaḥ ||
english: May we be lords of the possessions to be distributed, of the spontaneous wealth, of the eternal riches; O Agni, there is no residue born of another kind — do not lead astray the path of the mindless one.

sanskrit: nahi grabhāyāraṇaḥ suśevo 'nyodaryomanasamantavā u | adhā cid okaḥ punar it sa ety ā no vājy abhīṣāḻ etu navyaḥ ||
english: The foreign one, though pleasant, born of another womb, is not truly to be grasped — it must be thought over with the mind; yet even he returns to his home again; may the new prize-winner come to us victorious.

sanskrit: tvam agne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvam u naḥ sahasāvann avadyāt | saṁ tvā dhasmanvad abhy etu pāthaḥ saṁ rayiḥ spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī ||
english: Protect us, O Agni, from the assailant; protect us, O mighty one, from disgrace; may the dusty path converge toward you, and with it the thousandfold wealth worthy of longing.

sanskrit: etā no agne saubhagā didīhy api kratuṁ sucetasaṁ vatema | viśvā stotṛbhyo gṛṇate ca santu yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Illuminate these auspicious things for us, O Agni; may we attain to clear-minded wisdom; may all these be for those who praise and hymn you; preserve us evermore with blessings.

sanskrit: prāgnaye tavase bharadhvaṁ giraṁ divo arataye pṛthivyāḥ | yo viśveṣām amṛtānām upasthe vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhe jāgṛvadbhiḥ ||
english: Bring forth your song to Agni the mighty, the pillar of heaven and earth; Vaiśvānara who has grown great in the lap of all the immortals, with those who keep vigil.

sanskrit: pṛṣṭo divi dhāyy agniḥ pṛthivyāṁ netā sindhūnāṁ vṛṣabhaḥ stiyānām | sa mānuṣīr abhi viśo vi bhāti vaiśvānaro vāvṛdhāno vareṇa ||
english: Agni is stationed in heaven and on earth; he is the leader of rivers, the bull of the standing waters; Vaiśvānara, grown great with his excellence, shines upon the human peoples.

sanskrit: tvad bhiyā viśa āyann asikṇīr asamanā jahatī bhōjanāni | vaiśvānara pūrave śośucānaḥ puro yad agne darayann adīdeḥ ||
english: Out of fear of you the dark peoples came, abandoning their unequal food; O Vaiśvānara, when you shone for Pūru, blazing, bursting open the enemy cities, O Agni.

sanskrit: tava tridhātu pṛthivī uta dyaur vaiśvānara vratam agne sacanta | tvam bhāsā rodasī ā tatanthajastreṇa śociṣā śośucānaḥ ||
english: Your threefold ordinance, O Vaiśvānara, O Agni, is followed by both earth and heaven; you have stretched out both world-halves with your light, blazing with your unceasing flame.

sanskrit: tvām agne harito vāvaśānā giraḥ sacante dhunayo ghṛtācīḥ ||patiṁ kṛṣṭīnāṁ rathyaṁ rayīṇāṁ vaiśvānaram uṣasāṁ ketum ahnām ||
english: You, O Agni, the tawny, yearning hymns follow — the rushing, ghee-laden songs — calling you lord of the peoples, charioteer of wealth, Vaiśvānara, beacon of the dawns and of the days.

sanskrit: tve asuryanṁ vasavo ny ṛṇvan kratuṁ hi te mitramaho juṣanta | tvaṁ dasyūṁr okaso agna āja uru jyotir janayann āryāya ||
english: The Vasus have established lordly power in you; the great Mitra-friends have enjoyed your wisdom; you drove the Dasyus from their homes, O Agni, generating broad light for the Ārya.

sanskrit: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyoman vāyur na pāthaḥ pari pāsi sadyaḥ | tvam bhuvanā janayann abhi krann apatyāya jātavedo daśasyan ||
english: Being born in the highest heaven, you at once guard the path like Vāyu; striding forth to generate the worlds, O Jātavedas, you bestow on offspring.

sanskrit: tām agne asme iṣam erayasva vaiśvānara dyumatīṁ jātavedaḥ | yayā rādhaḥ pinvasi viśvavāra pṛthu śravo dāśuṣe martyāya ||
english: Direct that luminous refreshment toward us, O Agni Vaiśvānara, O Jātavedas — by which you fatten the bounty, O all-desired one, and give wide fame to the mortal worshipper.

sanskrit: taṁ no agne maghavadbhyaḥ purukṣuṁ rayiṁ ni vājam śrutyam yuvasva | vaiśvānara mahi naḥ śarma yaccha rudrebhir agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
english: Yoke for our patrons that abundant, glorious, prize-giving wealth, O Agni; O Vaiśvānara, grant us great shelter together with the Rudras and Vasus, O Agni.

sanskrit: pra samrājo asurasya praśastim puṁsaḥ kṛṣṭīnām anumādyasya | indrasyeva pra tavasa kṛtāni vande dāruṁ vandamāno vivakmi ||
english: I proclaim and praise the glory of the universal king, the mighty lord, the one to be extolled among the peoples — the mighty deeds like those of Indra; worshipping, I speak praise of the wood-Agni.

sanskrit: kaviṁ ketuṁ dhāsim bhānum adrer hinvanti śaṁ rājyaṁ rodasyoḥ | puraṁdarasya gīrbhir ā vivāse 'gner vratāni pūrvyā mahāni ||
english: The seer, the beacon, the nourisher, the light of the rock — they urge forward the auspicious sovereignty of both worlds; with songs like those of the city-breaker I seek the ancient great ordinances of Agni.

sanskrit: ny akratūn grathino mṛdhravācaḥ paṇīṁr aśraddhāṁ avṛdhāṁ ayajñān | pra-pra tān dasyūṁr agnir vivāya pūrvaś cakārāparāṁ ayajyūn ||
english: The Paṇis, the knotted ones, the mumbling, the faithless, the ungrowing, the unsacrificing — Agni has repeatedly driven those Dasyus away; he made the former the latter, the non-sacrificers.

sanskrit: yo apācīne tamasi madantīḥ prācīś cakāra nṛtamaḥ śacībhiḥ | tam īśānaṁ vasvo agniṁ gṛṇīṣe 'nānataṁ damayantam pṛtanyūn ||
english: I praise that Agni, the mightiest in his deeds, who by his powers made the revelling ones in the western darkness into eastern ones — him who is lord of wealth, unbowed, who tames the attackers.

sanskrit: yo dehyo anamayd vadhasanair yo aryapatnīr uṣasaś cakāra | sa nirudhyā nahuṣo yahvo agnir viśaś cakre balihṛtaḥ sahobhiḥ ||
english: He who bent down the fortifications with his weapons, who made the dawns into consorts of the noble — that youthful Agni of Nahuṣa's people, by his powers, made the clans bring tribute.

sanskrit: yasya śarmann upa viśve janāsa evais tasthuḥ sumatiṁ bhikṣamāṇāḥ | vaiśvānaro varam ā rodasyorāgniḥ sasāda pitror upastham ||
english: All peoples rest in his protection, seeking his goodwill with their customs; Agni Vaiśvānara, the best of both worlds, has seated himself in the lap of the father and mother.

sanskrit: ā devo dade budhn yā vasūni vaiśvānara uditā sūryasya | ā samudrād avarād ā parasmād āgnir dade diva ā pṛthivyāḥ ||
english: The god Vaiśvānara has taken the deep treasures at the rising of the sun; Agni has taken from the near sea and from the far, from heaven and from earth.

sanskrit: pra vo devaṁ cit sahasānam agnim aśvaṁ na vājinaṁ hiṣe namobhiḥ | bhavā no dūto adhvarasya vidvān tmanā deveṣu vivide mitadruḥ ||
english: I urge forward for you even the powerful god Agni with reverences, as one urges a swift horse; be our knowing messenger of the sacrifice, O measuring one who is found among the gods through his own self.

sanskrit: ā yāhy agne pathyā anu svā mandro devānāṁ sakhyaṁ juṣāṇaḥ | ā sānu śuṣmair nadayan pṛthivyā jambhebhir viśvam uśadhag vanāni ||
english: Come, O Agni, along your own paths, joyful, enjoying the friendship of the gods; making the back of earth resound with your powers, you gladly burn up all the forests with your jaws.

sanskrit: prācīno yajñaḥ sudhitaṁ hi barhiḥ prīṇīte agnir īḷito na hotā | ā mātarā viśvavāre huvāno yato yaviṣṭha jajñiṣe suśevaḥ ||
english: The eastward-directed sacrifice, the well-laid sacred grass — Agni the invoked one pleases these, as a hotr-priest; calling upon the two all-desired mothers, O youngest, kindly one, from whom you were born.

sanskrit: sadyo adhvare rathiraṁ jananta mānuṣāso vicetaso ya eṣām | viśām adhāyi viśpatir duroṇe 'gnir mandro madhuvacā ṛtāvā ||
english: The wise, discerning men of understanding instantly produce the expert charioteer at the sacrifice; Agni, the lord of the clans, has been placed in the house — joyous, honey-voiced, master of ṛta.

sanskrit: asādi vṛto vahnir ājagānvān agnir brahmā nṛṣadane vidhartā | dyauś ca yam pṛthivī vāvṛdhāte ā yaṁ hotā yajati viśvavāram ||
english: The chosen carrier has sat down, the one who has come — Agni the brahman-priest, the ordainer, who sits among men; both heaven and earth nourish him, and the hotr-priest sacrifices to him, the all-desired.

sanskrit: ete dyumnebhir viśvam ātiranta mantram ye vāraṁ naryā atakṣan | pra ye viśas tiranta śroṣamāṇā ā ye me asya dīdhayann ṛtasya ||
english: These have surpassed all with their glories — those manly ones who have fashioned the prayer and the choicest thing; who, hearkening, move the clans forward, who have meditated upon this truth of mine.

sanskrit: nū tvām agna īmahe vasiṣṭhā īśānaṁ sūno sahaso vasūnām | iṣaṁ stotṛbhyo maghavadbhya ānaḍ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Now we Vasiṣṭhas implore you, O Agni, as lord of wealth, O son of strength; carry refreshment to the praisers and the generous patrons; preserve us evermore with blessings.

sanskrit: indhe rājā sam aryo namobhir yasya pratīkam āhutaṁ ghṛtena | naro havyebhir īḷate sabādha āgnir agra uṣasām aśoci ||
english: The king is kindled together by the people with reverences, he whose face has been offered ghee; the men press together to propitiate him with oblations — Agni has shone at the forefront of the dawns.

sanskrit: ayam u ṣya sumahāṁ avedi hotā mandro manuṣo yahvo agniḥ | vi bhā akaḥ sasṛjānaḥ pṛthivyāṁ kṛṣṇapavir oṣadhībhir vavakṣe ||
english: He has been recognized as exceedingly great — the hotr-priest, the joyful, youthful Agni of Manu; spreading out light across the earth, with the dark-rimmed wheel he has swelled among the herbs.

sanskrit: kayā no agne vi vasaḥ suvṛktiṁ kām u svadhām ṛṇavaḥ śasyamānaḥ | kadā bhavema patayaḥ sudatra rāyo vantāro duṣṭarasya sādhoḥ ||
english: With what will you clothe us in excellent praise, O Agni? What self-power will you grant when sung? When shall we be lords, O good giver, winning wealth that is hard to overcome and perfect?

sanskrit: pra-prāyam agnir bharatasya śṛṇve vi yat sūryo na rocate bṛhad bhāḥ | abhi yaḥ pūrum pṛtanāsu tasthau dyutāno daivyo atithiḥ śuśoca ||
english: This Agni of Bharata is proclaimed everywhere, shining with great brilliance like the sun; he who has stood over Pūru in battles, the divine guest, blazing, has shone forth.

sanskrit: asann it tve āhavanāni bhūri bhuvo viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ | stutaś cid agne śṛṇviṣe gṛṇānaḥ svayaṁ vardhasva tanvaṁ sujāta ||
english: Let the many invocations be real in you; be well-disposed with all your flames; even when praised, O Agni, you are heard when you are hymned; increase yourself by your own body, O well-born one.

sanskrit: idaṁ vacaḥ śatasāḥ saṁsahasram ud agnaye janiṣīṣṭa dvibarhāḥ | śaṁ yat stotṛbhya āpaye bhavāti dyumad amīvacātanaṁ rakṣohā ||
english: May this word, hundredfold and thousandfold, rise up doubly great for Agni; that it may be auspicious for the praisers and the household, shining, disease-removing, demon-slaying.

sanskrit: nū tvām agna īmahe vasiṣṭhā īśānaṁ sūno sahaso vasūnām | iṣaṁ stotṛbhyo maghavadbhya ānaḍ yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Now we Vasiṣṭhas implore you, O Agni, as lord of wealth, O son of strength; carry refreshment to the praisers and the generous patrons; preserve us evermore with blessings.

sanskrit: abodhi jāra uṣasām upasthād hotā mandraḥ kavitamaḥ pāvakaḥ | dadhāti ketum ubhayasya jantor havyā deveṣu draviṇaṁ sukṛtsu ||
english: The wooer has awoken from the lap of the dawns — the joyful hotr-priest, the most poetic, the purifier; he sets the beacon of both kinds of beings and the oblations for the gods, wealth for the pious.

sanskrit: sa sukratur yo vi duraḥ paṇīnām punāno arkam purubhojasaṁ naḥ | hotā mandro viśāṁ damūnās tiras tamo dadṛśe rāmyāṇām ||
english: He is the wise one who bursts open the doors of the Paṇis, purifying the richly nourishing sun-beam for us; the joyful hotr-priest, the domestic one of the clans, is seen through the darkness of the nights.

sanskrit: amūraḥ kavir aditir vivasvān susaṁsan mitro atithiḥ śivo naḥ | citrabhānur uṣasāṁ bhāty agre 'pāṁ garbhaḥ prasva ā viveśa ||
english: The faultless seer, Aditi, Vivasvat, the well-spoken Mitra, the auspicious guest to us — Agni of brilliant radiance shines at the fore of the dawns; the embryo of the waters has entered into the plants.

sanskrit: īḷenyo vo manuṣo yugeṣu samanagā aśucaj jātavedāḥ | susaṁdṛśā bhānanā yo vibhāti prati gāvaḥ samidhānam budhanta ||
english: The praiseworthy one for you, Jātavedas has blazed undimmed through the generations of Manu; he who shines with beautiful radiance — the cows have recognized him as he is kindled.

sanskrit: agne yāhi dūtyam mā riṣaṇyo devāṁ acchā brahmakṛtā gaṇena | sarasvatīm maruto aśvinā po yakṣi devān ratnadheyāya viśvān ||
english: O Agni, go on your divine embassy, unharmed, toward the gods with the brahman-made band; sacrifice to Sarasvatī, the Maruts, the Aśvins, the waters, and all the gods for the bestowal of treasure.

sanskrit: tvām agne samidhāno vasiṣṭho jarūthaṁ han yakṣi rāye puraṁdhim | puruṇīthā jātavedo jarasva yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
english: Vasiṣṭha, kindling you, O Agni, strikes away Jarūtha; worship the bountiful goddess for wealth; of many kinds of ritual, O Jātavedas, grow old; preserve us evermore with blessings.

sanskrit: uṣo na jāraḥ pṛthu pājo aśred davidyutad dīdyac chośucānaḥ | vṛṣā hariḥ śucir ā bhāti bhāsā dhiyo hinvāna uśatīr ajīgaḥ ||
english: Like the lover of the dawn, he has reached his broad force, flashing, shining, blazing; the bull, the golden one, the pure, shines with his light; he who urges on prayers has stirred the eager ones.

sanskrit: svar ṇa vastor uṣasām aroci yajñaṁ tanvānā uśijo na manma | agnir janmāni deva ā vi vidvān dravad dūto devayāvā vaniṣṭhaḥ ||
english: Like the sun at the dawning of the days, he has shone forth; the prayer-devotees spread the sacrifice like a thought; Agni the god, knowing all births, runs as the messenger, devoted to the gods, the most winning.

sanskrit: acchā giro matayo devayantīr agniṁ yanti draviṇam bhikṣamāṇāḥ | susaṁdṛśaṁ supratīkaṁ svañcaṁ havyavāham araṭim mānuṣāṇām ||
english: The songs and prayers, desiring the gods, go to Agni begging for wealth — to him who is beautiful to behold, of fair visage, of good form, the bearer of oblations, the unwearying one of mankind.

sanskrit: indraṁ no agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣā rudraṁ rudrebhir ā vahā bṛhantam | ādityebhir aditiṁ viśvajanyāṁ bṛhaspatim ṛkvabhir viśvavāram ||
english: O Agni, bring Indra together with the Vasus, bring the great Rudra together with the Rudras; bring Aditi with the Ādityas, she who belongs to all peoples; bring Bṛhaspati with the ṛk-singers, the all-desired one.

sanskrit: mandraṁ hotāram uśijo yaviṣṭham agniṁ viśa īḻate adhvareṣu | sa hi kṣapāvāṁ abhavad rayīṇām atandro dūto yajathāya devān ||
english: The clans praise at the sacrificial rites Agni the joyful hotr-priest, loved by the devout, the youngest; for he has become the lord of nights and of riches, the unwearied messenger for the worship of the gods.
